    click 'Continue with Google. Opens in new tab' : label
    click 'Continue with Google. Opens in new tab' : label
    click 'Continue with Google. Opens in new tab' : label
  n4 --> n5
  n5 --> n5
    fill 'Email or phone number' : label = 'test@gmail.com'
    click 'primaryButton' : testid
    click 'primaryButton' : testid
